test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.

Stop something from burning
solution:
The correct answer is **"Extinguish".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Stop something from burning(**कुछ जलने से रोकें)**: **means to put out the fire, douse off or extinguish something from burning.(आग बुझाओ,अाग बुझाना)

 
 
• ***Example: ****Firemen fought for hours to* ***extinguish*** *the blaze.*
 
 
 
• With the meanings given above, we can say that option **2 is the correct answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** 

__
 
• ** Let's see the meaning of other words given in the options.**

 
 
• **Prevent:- **keep (something) from happening
 
• **Torch:- **a portable battery-powered electric lamp. (British Meaning)
 
• **Scorch:- **burn the surface of (something) with flame or heat 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some other words related to **Extinguish**.

 
 
• ​ **Snuff out **(phrasal verb ): To make a flame stop burning by squeezing it with your fingers or covering it with a snuffer.
 
• ** Stamp Out**** **(phrasal verb): To make a fire stop burning by putting your feet down hard on it.
